highlights:
# Modal上调GPU算力价格，高端卡涨幅最高达27%

原标题: Tell HN: Modal is raising its price

Ask HN· pierre· 11月3日 04:40·约2分钟阅读🌐 译

## 📋 总体概括

AI 云平台 Modal 在 Hacker News 上被曝出即将上调 GPU 租用价格，涉及从 B300、B200、H200、H100 到 A100、L40S、L4、T4 的全线产品。其中高端 Blackwell 系列涨幅最为明显，B300 从每小时 7.10 美元涨至 8.99 美元，B200 从 6.25 美元涨至 7.49 美元；而 A10、L4、T4 等低端卡价格反而小幅下调，呈现出明显的结构性调价特征。

## 🔑 关键信息

- ▸ B300 由 $7.10/hr 涨至 $8.99/hr，涨幅约 27%，为全表最高
- ▸ B200 由 $6.25 涨至 $7.49，H200 SXM 由 $4.54 涨至 $4.99，H100 SXM5 由 $3.95 涨至 $4.29
- ▸ A100 80GB/40GB 分别涨至 $2.69 与 $2.19，L40S 微涨至 $1.99
- ▸低端卡逆势降价：A10/A10G 降至 $0.99，L4 降至 $0.74，T4 降至 $0.54
- ▸调价呈现“高端涨、低端降”的结构性特征，而非全面普涨

## ⚡ 犀利点评

这轮调价本质上是供需信号：Blackwell 新卡产能紧张、需求旺盛，平台顺势提价；老卡则面临过剩，只能降价清库存。对依赖 Modal 跑推理和微调的开发者来说，高端算力成本上升会直接压缩利润空间，也提醒大家别把算力预算建立在“价格只降不升”的假设上。

results.title: How does Modal pricing work for training and fine-tuning? | Nodus Blog
results.author: Nodus Compute Engineering
highlights:
Nov 6, 2026 - 9 min read 

Modal bills a training run per second across three meters, GPU, CPU cores and memory, and multiplies the sum by 1.15x or 1.75x if you pin a region. Nodus lists the same NVIDIA H100 at $2.60/hr on its pricing page, against $3.95/hr for Modal’s GPU meter alone, and restores your checkpoint when a machine is reclaimed. On Modal, a preempted run that starts over is billed again, so checkpointing is part of the price.

...

## What does Modal charge for while a training job runs?

Modal bills each running container for three things at once. The GPU meter is the big one, and CPU and memory are charged on top of it, per second, at the amounts you request or actually use, whichever is higher.

| Meter | Modal list rate | Per hour |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NVIDIA H100 SXM | $0.001097 / sec | $3.9492 |
| NVIDIA B200 | $0.001736 / sec | $6.2496 |
| NVIDIA A100 80 GB | $0.000694 / sec | $2.4984 |
| CPU, per physical core (2 vCPU) | $0.0000131 / sec | $0.04716 |
| Memory, per GiB | $0.00000222 / sec | $0.007992 |
| Volumes | $0.09 per GiB-month, first 1 TiB free | |
| Network egress | $0.04 per GiB beyond the plan’s included amount | |

Prices checked November 6, 2026, from modal.com/pricing. Hourly figures are the per-second rates times 3,600.

Two details on that page are easy to miss. Each container has a minimum request of 0.125 cores and 128 MiB, and you pay for the higher of what you request and what you use. Modal also says it may run a `gpu="H100"` request on an H200, or a `gpu="A100"` request on an 80 GB A100, without changing the price. A `gpu="B200+"` request is billed as B200 even when it lands on a B300 (GPU guide).

...

## How does the same run price on Nodus?

Nodus quotes compute per machine instead of per meter, so a GPU’s hourly rate already includes the CPU and memory that come with it. The H100 SXM is listed at $2.60/hr on the Nodus pricing page and the B200 at $5.50/hr, and our docs say the rate is frozen when capacity is acquired (usage and costs).

results.title: Free GPU hours on Modal: what $30 a month really buys
highlights:
Modal, a serverless GPU cloud, gives every workspace on its free Starter plan $30 of compute every month. GPUs are billed by the second and apps can scale to zero, so that credit turns into real GPU time: about 6.6 hours on an H200, 12 hours on an A100 80 GB or 37 hours on an L4.

...

## How many GPU hours $30 buys

Modal's pricing page lists GPU prices per second. Multiply by 3,600 for the hourly rate, then divide $30 by it:

| GPU | GPU memory | Price per hour | Hours for $30 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| H200 | 141 GB | $4.54 | 6.6 |
| H100 | 80 GB | $3.95 | 7.6 |
| RTX PRO 6000 | 96 GB | $3.03 | 9.9 |
| A100 80 GB | 80 GB | $2.50 | 12.0 |
| A100 40 GB | 40 GB | $2.10 | 14.3 |
| L40S | 48 GB | $1.95 | 15.4 |
| A10 | 24 GB | $1.10 | 27.2 |
| L4 | 24 GB | $0.80 | 37.5 |
| T4 | 16 GB | $0.59 | 50.8 |

Treat these as ceilings. CPU cores and memory are metered alongside the GPU, so a real workload gets a little less. Pinning containers to a region multiplies prices by 1.15 to 1.75, so leave placement to Modal unless you need it. One small bonus: according to Modal's GPU guide, a plain `gpu="H100"` request may run on an H200 at no extra cost.

...

Prices and docs checked November 3, 2026. Modal can change its plans, prices and free credits at any time.

# Cloud GPU pricing, October 2026: what an H100, H200, B200 or B300 costs per hour

Listed per GPU-hour prices for B300, B200, H200, H100, A100, L40S, L4 and RTX cards as of October 8, 2026, with a training-run cost example.

 Nodus Compute Engineering Oct 8, 2026 · 3 min read 

NODUS/ BLOG pricing

On this page

1. 01 Data center GPUs
2. 02 Budget and prosumer GPUs
3. 03 Which one should you rent?
4. 04 What the hourly rate does not tell you
5. 05 FAQ

 Oct 8, 2026 - 3 min read 

Short answer (Oct 8, 2026): the Nodus pricing page lists an H100 SXM 80 GB at $2.60/hr, H200 SXM at $3.59/hr, B200 at $5.50/hr and B300 at $6.94/hr. Consumer and prosumer cards go much lower: an RTX 4090 is $0.29/hr and an RTX 3090 is $0.18/hr. Modal’s listed rates for the same data center GPUs run from 2% higher (B300) to about 2.5x higher (L40S) depending on the card.

Prices below are per GPU-hour, USD, taken from the public Nodus pricing page on October 8, 2026, which lists Modal’s published rate beside each one.

## Data center GPUs

| GPU | VRAM | Nodus | Modal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B300 | 288 GB | $6.943 | $7.099 |
| B200 | 180 GB | $5.500 | $6.250 |
| H200 SXM | 141 GB | $3.593 | $4.540 |
| H100 SXM | 80 GB | $2.600 | $3.949 |
| A100 | 80 GB | $1.090 | $2.498 |
| A100 | 40 GB | $0.904 | $2.099 |
| RTX PRO 6000 | 96 GB | $1.350 | $3.031 |
| L40S | 48 GB | $0.793 | $1.951 |
| L4 | 24 GB | $0.430 | $0.799 |

...

## What the hourly rate does not tell you

1. Boot and teardown. Some platforms bill from machine creation to deletion. On Nodus the bill is split into `Boot`, `Running` and `Teardown` segments so you can see it.
2. Price changes mid-run. Nodus freezes the rate when the machine is chosen for the whole run.
3. Interruptions. Spot capacity is cheaper, but only if your job checkpoints. Otherwise one preemption can wipe out the savings. See our preemption guide.
4. Reserved terms. For multi-month commitments on B200/B300, reserved pricing is quoted separately and depends on term length, location and interconnect. Nodus handles these through Reserved Compute.

...

What is the cheapest H100 per hour in October 2026? The Nodus pricing page lists an H100 SXM 80 GB at $2.60/hr as of Oct 8, 2026. Run `nodus run --dry-run` for the estimate for your exact job.

results.title: The H100 got more expensive · Three Phase. Potentia Intelligence.
results.author: Jose Mir
highlights:
### One Big Thing · Phase 3 · Compute

What happened: Nebius raised on-demand GPU prices on October 1, its second hike in about three months. Independent trackers show the same direction across the market.

Why it matters: The bear case on AI infrastructure assumed GPUs lose value fast. Rental rates are the cleanest test of that assumption, and so far the test is failing.

By the numbers:

- Nebius list price for an H100 went from $3.85 to $4.50 per GPU-hour; B300 from $7.85 to $9.50.
- The Ornn H100 index settled at $3.17 on October 23, up about 4% in a month.
